keptItems.title: Photos: The Aftermath of Nepal’s Flash Floods
keptItems.summaryEvidence: Jiang Fan / Xinhua / Getty This photo shows search-and-rescue operations under way at the mudslide-hit area in Gyirong County, China’s Xizang Autonomous Region, on August 29, 2026. Rajesh Kumar Singh / AP A drone view shows rescue workers inspecting damaged structures following flash flooding along the Trishuli River in the Devighat area of Nuwakot district, Nepal, on August 29, 2026. Niranjan Shrestha / AP A student searches for her schoolbag in a pile of backpacks extracted from the mud in the Shree Bagheswori Madhyamik School in Galchhi, Dhading district, Nepal, on August 30, 2026. Rajesh Kumar Singh / AP A drone view of a bridge damaged by the flooding in the Tadi River in the Devighat area of Nuwakot district, Nepal, on August 29, 2026 Dar Yasin / AP People look at photographs of unidentified flood victims displayed outside a government hospital to help relatives identify their loved ones in Kathmandu, Nepal, on August 28, 2026. Arun Sankar / AFP / Getty Police personnel rescue stranded residents from a house buried in sludge after flash flooding along the Trishuli River in Nepal, on August 27, 2026. Rajesh Kumar Singh / AP Damaged homes filled with mud and debris are seen in Devighat, Nepal, on August 29, 2026. Daniel Ceng / Anadolu / Getty A rescue helicopter takes off for an evacuation operation in Nuwakot, Nepal, on August 29, 2026. Prabin Ranabhat / AFP / Getty Rescued residents react as they meet family members at an army camp after the flooding, in Battar Bazar, Nepal, on August 28, 2026.
